queuePolicy: Dependency-first, then P0/P1/P2; phase prompts are review boundaries, not permission to skip gates.

tasks.title: Record and reconcile the current repository
tasks.implementation: Read current contracts and create a conflict/reuse map. The recorded commit is a reference, not a required reset target.
acceptance: Record git HEAD, dirty files, Node version and existing scripts.
Map earlier CINE/VIS/S work to reuse, extend or unnecessary; do not overwrite user edits.
Run available baseline checks and record failures without relabelling skipped checks.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Resolve a changing repository baseline and overlapping CINE/VIS/S contracts before editing.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A minimal conflict map still contains incompatible schema or exporter assumptions after two distinct, evidenced analyses.

tasks.title: Inventory real host capabilities
tasks.implementation: Probe documented local capabilities without modifying host settings; unavailable clients become explicit blockers for host-only tests.
acceptance: Record actual Codex/Claude versions only when available.
Keep local tests, installation, enablement and real invocation as separate states.
Do not use an undocumented Slides command or infer account entitlements.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: The work is bounded capability inspection rather than new architecture.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Observed version/help output contradicts the documented capability contract; unavailable binaries are blockers, not a reason to increase effort.

tasks.title: Adopt corrected evidence and rights rules
tasks.implementation: Resolve research conflicts before code generation. Preserve screenshot/library/frame distinctions and the partial corpus label.
acceptance: Original reports remain non-normative.
No example Lab values or unsupported API calls enter production code.
Every planned imported asset has a provenance/licence disposition.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Keep source evidence, inferred design rules and asset rights distinct.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Sources disagree or rights remain uncertain: preserve the unresolved finding and obtain primary evidence; do not solve missing evidence by escalating effort.

tasks.title: Capture regression fixtures
tasks.implementation: Use existing harnesses; a baseline image without the underlying project and command is insufficient.
acceptance: Create six representative slide fixtures using current supported contracts.
Capture current exports and measured render paths.
Locks, source links, values and notes have explicit invariants.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Freeze representative fixtures and exact content invariants using the existing harness.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A fixture cannot reproduce the same source/lock invariants across current pipelines; isolate that mismatch before changing the harness.

tasks.title: Integrate immutable palette registry
tasks.implementation: Map PALETTES.json into the current theme registry; add a versioned palette schema without weakening existing project validation.
acceptance: 22 unique seed palette IDs; Rushmore remains an alias, not a duplicate.
Library values and screenshot samples remain separate.
Film timestamps stay null until a real frame record exists.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Registry integration is constrained by immutable seed data and the existing theme contract.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: An explicit schema migration changes old saved projects or creates conflicting palette identities.

tasks.title: Resolve semantic light dark and stage tokens
tasks.implementation: Use the supplied color functions as reference; account for actual backgrounds, alpha blending and exports.
acceptance: Derived roles never overwrite source RGBs.
Normal text pairs meet 4.5:1 without rounding; meaningful strokes meet 3:1 where required.
Stage body policy targets 7:1; status colours stay semantic and independent of the movie theme.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Colour roles, composited backgrounds and multiple exporters must agree numerically.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A reproducible alpha, transfer-function or export discrepancy survives two distinct fixes with numeric test vectors.

tasks.title: Make chart and diagram roles accessible
tasks.implementation: Direct labels, strokes, patterns and a readable data table provide redundant information channels.
acceptance: No colour-only series/part identity.
Adjacency checks cover marks, arrows and callout boundaries.
Categorical swatches are never silently used as a sequential magnitude scale.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Chart and diagram identities must survive colour, label, pattern and output changes.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Accessible redundant encodings conflict with native export: split by component and test the contract rather than using unbounded retries.

tasks.title: Expose palette evidence in one picker
tasks.implementation: Use small metadata in the picker and an expandable evidence view; movie provenance does not belong as a giant on-slide logo.
acceptance: One theme/palette picker, not a second competing design panel.
Show community-derived status without crowding the slide.
Switching a palette preserves content, locks and undo.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: A single picker and its evidence disclosure reuse known shell patterns.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Changing a palette unexpectedly alters locks, undo or author-selected composition.

tasks.title: Add bounded multiple-document intake
tasks.implementation: Reuse existing importers; distinguish supported parsing from desired future formats. Preserve duplicates and source ordering.
acceptance: Text and Markdown work offline with per-document hashes and locators.
PDF/DOCX adapters are enabled only after local parser/dependency review.
Encrypted, scanned or malformed documents yield explicit recovery and never silently vanish.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Untrusted documents, parser boundaries and multiple source locators create data-loss and security risks.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A small malicious/malformed fixture demonstrates unresolved parser isolation, resource-bound or source-loss behaviour after two targeted attempts.

tasks.title: Build claim source and contradiction records
tasks.implementation: Map onto existing sources/contentStatus/takeaway fields; add fields only through a tested explicit migration.
acceptance: Every factual claim is source-linked or evidence-required.
Contradictory numbers stay distinct with their attribution.
No imported text is executed as instructions.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Claim identity, contradictory values and source locators must survive explicit migrations.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A minimal round-trip fixture still loses or misbinds claims/sources after two hypothesis-driven attempts.

tasks.title: Review story before composition
tasks.implementation: Provide deterministic local outlining for pasted material; allow an explicitly supplied agent outline without hidden AI calls.
acceptance: The novice can review audience, outcome and a concise outline.
Approving a new plan preserves the prior project/copy.
At most three visible style directions; no required prompt syntax.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: The reviewed outline is a bounded local workflow with preserved project copies.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Accepting an outline changes existing source/lock semantics or requires a new planning contract.

tasks.title: Validate agent handoffs and project migrations
tasks.implementation: Do not treat a code-generation agent session as an API key or permission to bypass local security.
acceptance: Handoffs contain content, sources and declared capabilities, not credentials.
Unknown schema fields fail with a repair path.
Classic and visual/v3 inputs keep their contracts and round-trip invariants.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Agent handoffs cross trust and project-version boundaries.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A reproducible privilege, unknown-field or version-migration failure survives two isolated repairs.

tasks.title: Implement task-aware layout candidate policy
tasks.implementation: Reuse the existing candidate engine; preserve its measured text and grapheme constraints.
acceptance: Reject overflow and unreadable type before aesthetic scoring.
Six layout families have explicit logical reading order.
No mandatory F/Z or golden-ratio rule; self-paced and stage modes differ.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Measured typography, layout feasibility and target-specific geometry form a coupled constraint problem.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A fixed fixture cannot meet content, typography and geometry invariants after two documented candidate-policy fixes.

tasks.title: Separate claim citations from full references
tasks.implementation: Reduce citation clutter without deleting provenance; keep hyperlinks and export metadata where supported.
acceptance: Readable compact source keys remain near claims.
Full source metadata appears in an appendix/source view.
Warnings and essential qualifiers are never hidden as tiny footnotes.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Compact source display can reuse the existing references layer but needs strong fidelity review.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Reordering, disclosure or export breaks a claim-to-source link or hides an essential qualifier.

tasks.title: Protect dominant images and truthful charts
tasks.implementation: Use crop/placement and surrounding surfaces for integration rather than modifying image meaning.
acceptance: Figure-led slides allocate meaningful space to evidence.
Numeric values, axis policies, intervals and nulls survive layout/theme changes.
No default recolouring of evidence or colour-critical photos.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Subject framing and chart semantics must preserve data and protected regions.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Theme or geometry changes alter values, nulls, scales or protected subject bounds: split and repair the affected invariant.

tasks.title: Compose readable workflows and mechanism figures
tasks.implementation: Prefer editable vector/shape geometry; explain any per-asset fallback instead of hiding whole-slide rasterization.
acceptance: Stable part IDs, attached labels and directed edges.
Illustrations identify not-to-scale or unverified physical properties.
Step reveals have a complete, meaningful static export state.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Graph identity, labels, connectors and final static states must map to editable output.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A minimal mechanism graph exposes unresolved label/edge identity or editable-export mismatch after two targeted repairs.

tasks.title: Export the first complete native vertical slice
tasks.implementation: Create a six-page fixture deck and compare content counts/values, not just whether a PPTX zip opens.
acceptance: Preview and export use the same semantic scene.
Native text, shapes and supported chart/diagram objects are checked structurally.
Unsupported export behaviours are disclosed; original source project remains recoverable.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Preview, semantic scenes and native OOXML must preserve object editability and meaning.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A six-page fixture still differs structurally or visually between targets after two isolated fixes and a minimised reproducer.

tasks.title: Simplify the existing workbench shell
tasks.implementation: Keep current shell adapters; expose Words/Look/detail controls only where useful.
acceptance: One obvious next action in empty/import/review/export states.
No duplicate toolbars or dead gauges.
Viewport fit does not change slide coordinates or hide primary controls.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Refine the existing shell rather than redesigning application architecture.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Novice simplification removes a required state, recovery control or keyboard path.

tasks.title: Add accessible bounded slide dial
tasks.implementation: Use a native input foundation; visual metal is decoration over real semantics. Store active slide by stable ID.
acceptance: 0/1/N slide cases, reorder and current-slide deletion are safe.
Arrow/Home/End and visible alternatives work without a rotation gesture.
No global wheel/arrow hijack, IME interference or loss of focus.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Slide identity, drag/keyboard/touch input, IME and focus interact as a state machine.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A deterministic event trace still jumps to the wrong slide or loses focus after two isolated fixes.

tasks.title: Add quiet original detent feedback
tasks.implementation: Synthesize a short original tick; no TE sound files or promised physical haptics.
acceptance: Off by default and enabled only with a visible preference/user gesture.
No backlog of sounds during rapid scrubbing; background/presenter output is quiet.
Reduced motion and no-audio paths retain complete state feedback.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: A small original tick and explicit opt-in have a bounded local implementation.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A deterministic trace reveals audio backlog, a background/presenter leak or failure to respect the preference.

tasks.title: Test complete keyboard touch and recovery flows
tasks.implementation: Test existing shell controls as well as the new dial; audit the whole task, not just a component.
acceptance: Focus returns correctly after drawers/dialogs.
Saved-state conflicts and restore-as-copy remain intact.
Screen-reader/touch results are recorded separately from unit tests.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Recovery, history and whole-workflow input checks span several existing components.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A saved-state/reorder/restore event trace still loses data or focus after two targeted repairs.

tasks.title: Integrate only documented host capabilities
tasks.implementation: Use official skills/handoff contracts and existing plugin packaging; refuse guessed Slides API stubs.
acceptance: Record actual invocation in each available host with version.
Unavailable Spaces internal implementation is not a mandatory dependency.
Local generation stays useful with no host research capability.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Host adapters need documented interfaces and strict permission/usage boundaries.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Actual authorised host output conflicts with the handoff contract after two isolated fixes; missing access or quota is a blocker, not a trigger.

tasks.title: Evaluate Kimi compatibility as an isolated option
tasks.implementation: A negative feasibility result is acceptable; retain DeckWeft native export rather than adding a silent cloud fallback.
acceptance: Document remote writer/resource requirements and licences.
No automatic pip/browser install or remote load in the default path.
Compare editable fidelity and content preservation on a permitted fixture.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Compatibility and remote resource/licence constraints need a bounded feasibility decision.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A proprietary or unavailable dependency is required: record a negative feasibility result; do not escalate or install it to force success.

tasks.title: Extend film palette provenance deliberately
tasks.implementation: Do not promise every possible colour combination. Define a corpus/version and cluster representative scene palettes with explicit coverage.
acceptance: Verify dated filmography and define feature/short/ad scope.
Only permitted media is sampled; record edition, timestamp, transfer function and frame hash.
Scene and neutral/skin/subtitle handling, cluster seed, weighting and deduplication are reproducible.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Corpus, edition, transfer function, clustering and provenance need a reproducible method.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Evidence or permitted footage is missing: mark the corpus partial; revisit the method only when actual data reveals a reproducibility defect.

tasks.title: Complete product and recent-study coverage audit
tasks.implementation: Extend the targeted source review into a documented search protocol; do not relabel this package as an exhaustive survey.
acceptance: Review all catalogue links and historical-product scope, marking unavailable material.
Search current primary studies; record methods, samples, outcomes and access limits.
Separate attention, comprehension, preference and persuasion; no fabricated effect sizes.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Compare primary evidence without confusing attention, comprehension, preference and persuasion.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: Papers or catalogue records are incomplete or conflicting: obtain primary material and retain limits; reasoning cannot replace unavailable sources.

tasks.title: Run cross-mode visual and novice acceptance
tasks.implementation: Use TEST_PLAN.md; recruit a suitable sample and predefine task outcomes rather than inventing study results.
acceptance: All seed palettes and output modes have representative render checks.
Formative novices complete input/edit/export/recover tasks.
Comprehension and preference are reported separately with limitations.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Acceptance combines broad visual results with separately recorded novice task outcomes.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A cross-mode result fails the preregistered criterion: minimise the failing case and route it to its owning implementation task.

tasks.title: Open exports in real target applications
tasks.implementation: A local-only alpha may ship with documented limitations; never mark unavailable applications passed.
acceptance: Record PowerPoint/Keynote version and actual object-edit tests where available.
Real host invocation is recorded or explicitly blocked.
Structural OOXML tests do not substitute for rendering/application evidence.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Run prescribed application-open and edit checks and capture concrete evidence.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: The real application fails a fixture: capture the version/file/result and return the defect to DWI-034; a missing application is blocked.

tasks.title: Package reproducible offline release candidate
tasks.implementation: Build from source, not patched dist. Publication and repository push still require explicit user instruction.
acceptance: Fresh offline install/start/export succeeds on documented environment.
No user inputs, secrets, fonts or unlicensed assets leak into distribution.
Manifest, checksums, test logs and capability matrix accompany the archive.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Packaging is mostly deterministic but requires a careful privacy and reproducibility review.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: A fresh install fails, archive contents leak private material or byte provenance is unclear: isolate the packaging cause.

tasks.title: Close the handoff with truthful status
tasks.implementation: Provide completed/blocked/unstarted separation and the exact next executable task. Do not claim all original scope is complete.
acceptance: Each task links its evidence or named blocker.
Optional research/adapters are reported as partial when unfinished.
The user receives an actual artifact path, not a background-task claim.
tasks.pathStatus: mixture of inspected existing locations and explicit proposed additions; resolve in phase 00

modelRouting.reason: Summarise already verified artefacts and task states without changing application code.
modelRouting.escalationTrigger: The final status disagrees with logs or dependencies: raise to Medium to reconcile evidence, never infer success.
